column1: # Thai (th) interface catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:
#   context <TAB> English source <TAB> translation
#   context    empty, or `preview` for sample text inside a rendered preview tile
#   source     the English text exactly as in the code (tl!(...), ribbon labels, command labels)
#   escapes    \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns, and a
#              trailing "…" in one needs one in the other.
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A missing entry shows in English.
# Commands start with a bare verb (แทรกตาราง, บันทึกเป็น…); tabs, groups, panes and field labels
# are nouns (การแก้ไข, ความกว้าง). One space separates Thai from Latin letters, digits and
# placeholders ({words} คำ, หน้า {page} จาก {pages}); Thai words are never separated by spaces and
# sentences drop the English full stop. Digits stay Arabic (the inputs read them); unit symbols,
# key names and product and format names stay in Latin (12 pt, Ctrl+S, PDF, Doc4Me). Thai nouns
# have no plural, so counts take a classifier (ผู้ร่วมพัฒนา {contributors} คน). Loanwords follow
# the Royal Society's spelling (ฟอนต์, ลิงก์, อัปเดต, เวอร์ชัน); "Font" is always ฟอนต์ and the Home
# tab is หน้าหลัก (หน้าแรก is "first page"). Hyphenation is การใส่ยัติภังค์, never การตัดคำ.
# Clean room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label in ordinary
# Thai computing vocabulary. No Microsoft Word (or other product) localisation, string table or
# translated UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way.
